label: Capability compatibility map
description: A two-dimensional classification for artifact contracts and mechanism claims. Horizontal position records semantic commitment only; lanes remain orthogonal and do not define execution order.

axis.label: Semantic commitment
axis.description: Moves from source-bound observations at the left toward the exact product contract at the right. Position is not evidence maturity, priority, dependency, or build order.

positions.label: Native source
positions.description: Exact supplied-file and once-decoded native-raster custody without inferred visual meaning.

positions.label: Derived measurement
positions.description: Typed measurements or transforms whose semantics remain directly inspectable and bounded.

positions.label: Structured evidence
positions.description: Regions, graphs, masks, relationships, and other structured evidence without role authority.

positions.label: Semantic hypothesis
positions.description: Explicit alternatives or abstentions about fields, marks, roles, or other visual meaning.

positions.label: Bounded decision
positions.description: A typed election, construction, validation, or arbitration result under declared conditions.

positions.label: Exact product contract
positions.description: The complete four-role UI treatment, collapse state, optional rendered field, exact-pixel rules, and contract metadata.

lanes.label: Image and color custody
lanes.description: Encoded input, native pixels, color representations, and exact source witnesses.

lanes.label: Structure and field evidence
lanes.description: Spatial support, regions, topology, texture, field form, and field ownership hypotheses.

lanes.label: Roles and complete treatments
lanes.description: Candidate colors, role hypotheses, complete tuples, collapse, selection, and repair.

lanes.label: Validation and rendering
lanes.description: Mechanical invariants, contrast, rendering, robustness, and deterministic replay.

lanes.label: Development diagnostics
lanes.description: Development-only comparisons, sensitivity studies, synthetic controls, reports, and caches.

lanes.label: Models and external computation
lanes.description: Model artifacts, external observations, and research-only learned or literature-derived inputs.

lanes.label: Review and evidence custody
lanes.description: Question-scoped human records, known-good projections, adjudication, and evidence interpretation.

lanes.label: Configuration and governance
lanes.description: Configuration, controls, policy records, provenance, authorization, and source custody.

capabilities.label: Native source custody
capabilities.description: Preserve the exact supplied file and opaque native sRGB raster boundary.

capabilities.label: Pixel and color measurement
capabilities.description: Produce source-bound color, support, distance, or scalar measurements.

capabilities.label: Spatial structure evidence
capabilities.description: Represent masks, labels, regions, adjacency, topology, texture, and field evidence.

capabilities.label: Field and figure hypotheses
capabilities.description: Retain explicit, uncertain, competing, or absent field and figure interpretations.

capabilities.label: Role and identity hypotheses
capabilities.description: Describe foreground, accent, identity, and role alternatives without product authority.

capabilities.label: Treatment construction and arbitration
capabilities.description: Construct, retain, compare, or repair bounded complete-treatment alternatives.

capabilities.label: Exact UI treatment contract
capabilities.description: Express the exact four-role palette, collapse state, optional rendered field, and required metadata.

capabilities.label: Contract and render validation
capabilities.description: Validate mechanical legality and rendered-field behavior without claiming visual quality.

capabilities.label: Development diagnostics
capabilities.description: Measure changes, sensitivity, robustness, blast radius, and provenance outside product inference.

capabilities.label: Model-assisted diagnostics
capabilities.description: Represent model, external, or privileged diagnostic evidence under explicit restrictions.

capabilities.label: Review and evidence custody
capabilities.description: Preserve scoped review, accepted alternatives, adjudication, and exposure records.

capabilities.label: Configuration, control, and governance
capabilities.description: Make behavior-affecting configuration, controls, provenance, and governance records explicit.

left.label: Native raw raster
left.meaning: The once-decoded native-size opaque 8-bit sRGB raster is the fixed left product anchor.

right.label: Exact v3 UI Palette product contract
right.meaning: The complete published v3 UI Palette contract is the fixed right product goal.
